summary: Patch fixes PasswordObfuscator.obfuscate(query, opts) so the password is CQL-escaped (' to '') and matched with Pattern.quote(), which covers regex metacharacters and the \E sequence. Test changes add testPasswordWithRegexEndQuote and testAllPrintableSpecialCharactersObfuscation (plus helper assertPasswordObfuscated) to test/unit/org/apache/cassandra/cql3/PasswordObfuscatorTest.java. Checklists applied: the bundled cassandra-injvm-dtest SKILL.md (checked for suite fit only; the change is single-node string logic, so no in-JVM dtest is needed), plus the testing.md suite and regression rules. The regression test does fail on base: a '$', '+', '^', '(' or '[' embedded in the password is either a regex metacharacter or an invalid pattern on base, so the printable-character test records leaks or PatternSyntaxExceptions (the ticket's pre-fix output confirms this). Not reviewed: nothing; all three changed files were read in the diff, and the surrounding PasswordObfuscator code was read.

findings.rule: Coverage of the change: boundaries and combined inputs
findings.problem: testAllPrintableSpecialCharactersObfuscation only embeds one special character at a time in the word 'password'. The new code's interaction of CQL quote-doubling with Pattern.quote() is never exercised on passwords mixing several special characters, such as "a'$b", "$+?", "'\\E" or a password made only of metacharacters. A regression that handles only the first special character in a password would still pass this suite.
findings.fix: Add a small parameterized or table-driven case to testPasswordWithRegexEndQuote (or a new test) with multi-character mixes: "a'$b", "$+?^", "\\E'\\E", and a password consisting only of quote and regex characters, using the same assertPasswordObfuscated helper.

findings.rule: Test hygiene: constants and duplicated helper logic
findings.problem: ASCII_START and ASCII_END are declared public static final in a test class that only needs them internally. The per-character query/expected construction in testAllPrintableSpecialCharactersObfuscation (around line 301) duplicates assertPasswordObfuscated (line 279), so the two can drift apart.
findings.fix: Make the constants private, and have the loop call a shared helper that returns the obfuscated result, so both tests build the query and expected string the same way.
